title: Space/Cosmic
content: Apply cosmic space aesthetic with astronomical wonder. Dark space backgrounds (deep purple, black). Star fields with varying brightness. Nebula gradients: purple, pink, blue clouds. Planet and moon imagery. Include constellation patterns. Floating, zero-gravity feel to elements. Subtle sparkle animations. Galaxy spiral decorations. Add lens flare effects. Mysterious, vast, inspiring atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create cosmic space theme with stars, galaxies, nebulae, and astronomical wonder.
variants.detailed: Apply cosmic space aesthetic with astronomical wonder. Dark space backgrounds (deep purple, black). Star fields with varying brightness. Nebula gradients: purple, pink, blue clouds. Planet and moon imagery. Include constellation patterns. Floating, zero-gravity feel to elements. Subtle sparkle animations. Galaxy spiral decorations. Add lens flare effects. Mysterious, vast, inspiring atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply cosmic space aesthetic with astronomical wonder and scale. Base: deep space background (bg-slate-950, bg-purple-950, true black for stars to pop). Star field: layered - tiny dots (radial-gradient circles at random positions), varying sizes and opacities, some with twinkle animation (opacity pulsing). Nebulae: large blurred gradient shapes (blur-[100px]), colors: purple (#9c27b0), magenta (#e91e63), teal (#00bcd4), orange (#ff5722). Use mix-blend-mode: screen for layering. Galaxies: spiral patterns using SVG, star clusters with dense dot concentration. Planets: spherical elements with subtle gradient for 3D, rings optional, can peek into frame. Moons: crater textures, phase lighting (half-lit sphere). Constellations: star patterns connected with faint lines. Floating effect: elements with subtle drift animation, parallax on scroll. Cosmic dust: fine particle layer, gentle movement. Lens flare: radial gradient highlights, hexagonal artifacts. Typography: clean, modern fonts (Space Grotesk, Exo 2), or futuristic (Orbitron). Glow effects: text and elements with soft glow (text-shadow with spread). Interactive: stars twinkle more on hover, planets rotate slowly. Deep space: sense of layers - foreground stars, middle nebulae, distant galaxies. Implementation: multiple layered backgrounds, CSS animations for stars, SVG for complex elements. Performance: particle effects can be heavy - optimize or use CSS only. Accessibility: ensure text readable against busy space backgrounds.
